every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 keeps each active 3D station cleanly framed to the right across frames 1-9, whereas Site 1 overlaps its text card with 3D machinery in frames 5 and 6 and clips the label in frame 6.

explains_the_project.reason: Site 1 physically compresses a massive log slab through the press in frames 3-4, routes handles into open filing drawers in frame 5, and visualizes the seven harness gates in frame 8.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Site 2 features bolder, more cohesive industrial models with crisp bevels, metallic wear, and grounded floor outlines in frames 1, 6, and 8.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 2 uses sharper typographic hierarchy, color-coded numerical callouts in frames 3-8, and opaque cards that never collide with focal 3D subjects.

overall.reason: Site 2 delivers a cleaner, better-composed 3D scroll journey with superior model craft and unoccluded framing at every step.
